title.narrative: The project for promoting youth employment through automotive maintenance skills training

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to contribute to closing the skills gap in Sierra Leone#s automotive repair and maintenance service industry in order to support the country's National Development Plan (NDP) 2019-23. This will be achieved by 1) Developing and accrediting a competency-based and demand-driven modern curricula for automotive technician and entrepreneurship training; 2) Establishing a regional centre of excellence for automotive technician training; and 3) Providing vocational training, career services and business coaching to unemployed and underemployed youths, with a particular focus on female and disadvantaged students. The project builds on UNIDO#s extensive experience in the design and implementation of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) projects and Entrepreneurship Curriculum Programme (ECP).
